text:
maria: quick q — we need a consistent pattern for mapping Redwood API error responses to SDK exceptions across py/go. also how should req_id be surfaced during streaming reconnects?

devon: +1. can you paste an example response shape you want to map?

maria: here's a typical body we get from the runtime: 
```json
{
  "error": {
    "type": "rate_limited",
    "message": "Too many requests",
    "request_id": "r-8a3f9c2b",
    "status": 429
  }
}
```
we also sometimes get streaming partial frames with an `error` control frame that contains only request_id + code.

sam: for py sdk i'd do a hierarchy: ApiError(base) -> RateLimitError, AuthError, BadRequestError, StreamDisconnectError. include `.request_id` attr on all exceptions.

zach: same for go: package errors define typed errors that implement `Status() int` and `RequestID() string`. callers can switch on concrete types. keep the mapping table in one place (errors/map.go / errors/map.py).

maria: i sketched a minimal mapping table in the PR description. question: for streaming reconnects should we reuse the same request_id or surface the new one? logs are messy when reconnect gives a new rid and the app can't correlate.

devon: we decided server assigns a new request_id per connection/resume attempt. best practice: SDK should emit an event `streaming.reconnect` that includes `old_request_id` and `new_request_id` and bubble both in logs. also attach both to exceptions thrown on resume failures.

sam: ack. examples: 
Python raise: 
```py
raise RateLimitError(message, status=429, request_id=req_id)
# -> e.request_id available for logs
```
Go example: 
```go
if apiErr, ok := err.(errors.RequestIDer); ok {
  log.Printf("req=%s err=%v", apiErr.RequestID(), err)
}
```

zach: small nit — for stream partial frames we shouldn't raise full exceptions until the stream is terminal. Instead expose a `StreamError` callback with the request_id and code so app can decide whether to surface UI errors.

maria: good call. also adding debug logging hook to SDKs so app devs can opt-in to verbose protocol traces. partly because some customers need the raw frames for support.

devon: agree. implement a `set_debug_logger(logger)` on py and a `WithDebugLogger()` option on go ctor. make sure logs redact tokens but include request_id.

maria: @devon @zach i updated the PR with these examples and added tests for `request_id` propagation on resume. pinging reviewers: @sam @zach. small ask: can one of you also check the docs snippet about mapping codes -> exceptions?

sam: will review in 30m.

zach: on it, will particularly check go error interfaces.

deploy-bot: deploy queued: devex/sdks/error-mapping (sha: a1b2c3) to staging — started 1955554500

maria: thanks all — logging this for the SDK handbook under "error-handling and request ids". i'll move the PR to ready after comments. :thumbsup:
